raw_issues: No passing runtime profile report was produced.
runtime_failures: Workload did not include sufficient actual walking and complete toast flight.

warmup.workload: Same continuous active fixture; no idle-only warmup. Measurement begins without resetting the current motion.

conditions.audio: Normal runtime audio enabled; unique settings file, default volumes.
conditions.fixed_fps_source: Launcher explicitly runs normal real-time mode without --fixed-fps; absence is not inferred from consumed engine args.

workload.description: Prepared launch state and starting position are injected using model APIs. Subsequent ramp/ground walking, resize, boarding, and toast launch use production input/animation. Completion resets are explicit fixture events. This is not an ordinary-input completion test or a whole-campaign performance claim.

collector.frame_storage: Preallocated PackedFloat64Array time + interval columns and PackedByteArray flags
collector.note: Packed payload size is exact; container headers, backing-capacity rounding, allocator alignment, dictionaries and runtime bookkeeping are not included. Serialized diagnostic size is a reproducible content-size measure, not actual allocated RAM. Percentile/CSV/JSON construction occurs after active sampling and may raise later whole-process RSS. No claim that RSS growth equals game-only allocations.

external_python_sampler.note: macOS getrusage ru_maxrss is bytes and measures this separate Python process, including executable/PCK hashing. Serialized samples are content size, not allocated RAM. Game RSS is sampled only from the child PID.

rss.note: No collector-memory subtraction. Preallocated packed capacity is before warmup; growing diagnostic serialized bytes are not allocated RAM. Later loads/serialization are outside active sampling.

quantile_method: Sort ascending; select min(n-1,floor(n*p)), matching frozen collector.
limitations: Focus classified at callback endpoint; a crossing interval can span two focus states.
Focus segments/first-last windows differ in workload phase; not a causal focus experiment.
Prepared VS01 traversal with explicit resets; not whole-campaign or ordinary first play.
Frame intervals include VSync/cap waits and ordinary I/O, not isolated CPU or GPU cost.
Response probes end at changed transform on render-post-draw; no pixel readback or physical input-to-photon timing.
Thermal sensors, GPU timing/power, battery and other hardware remain unmeasured.
rendering_resource_recommendation: No renderer/resource reduction is justified by this failed workload. Correct collector foreground/pause/progress validation, prove complete repeated traversal, then rerun. RSS growth is not a leak finding or a thermal result.
